correctness.rationale: Start with the published unit-gain average fidelity F=(2I0(2zeta))^-1 sum_{m,n>=0}(zeta/2)^(m+n)(m+n)!/(m!² n!²), nonnegative and absolutely convergent for zeta>=0. At k=m+n, Vandermonde yields sum_m k!/(m!²(k-m)!²)=binom(2k,k)/k!, so the series becomes 1F1(1/2;1;2zeta). The Euler integral and t=(1+cos(theta))/2 give e^zeta I0(zeta), proving the exact Bessel quotient. Standard large-positive-x I0(x)~exp(x)/(sqrt(2pi x))*(1+1/(8x)+9/(128x²)+225/(3072x³)+...) then gives F=2^-1/2*(1+1/(16zeta)+25/(512zeta²)+491/(8192zeta³)+...), tending to 1/sqrt2 from above and eventually above 2/3. Independent mpmath rectangular double-series truncation agreed with Bessel quotient at zeta=0,0.5,1.2,4; independent symbolic rational division confirmed the three coefficients. Valid only at gain g=1.
correctness.risk: Finite double-sum truncation only checks selected zeta; equality and high-intensity asymptotic rest on exact Vandermonde/Kummer integral and Bessel expansion. No optimal-gain theorem.
